newsitem.title: CHINA: PRESS DIGEST - Shanghai newspapers - July 24.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Shanghai newspapers - July 24.

text.p: Following is a summary of major political and business stories in local newspapers, prepared by Reuters in Shanghai. Reuters has not checked the stories and does not guarantee their accuracy.
- SHANGHAI SECURITIES NEWS - The gross domestic product (GDP) of Shanghai's Pudong New Area hit 25.692 billion yuan in the first half of 1997, up 17.7 percent against the same 1996 period.

- Mao Yingliang, the head of the Shanghai branch of the central bank, said Shanghai would continue its appropriate tight money policy and strictly control the total volume of loans in the second half of 1997.
- BUSINESS NEWS - Non-state sectors have become new sources of growth, now accounting for 80 percent of economic growth.
- The number of private firms in Shanghai is growing rapidly, with 8,000 new companies opening for business in the first half of 1997.

- The financial sector of Shanghai's premier economic development zone of Pudong grew solidly in the first half of 1997, with total loans provided by 15 domestic banks reaching 180.58 billion yuan, up 30.7 percent from the year-ago period.
